npc_ulf_charcoal.name: Ulf
npc_ulf_charcoal.look: A wiry old man of nearly sixty, soot-blackened, with a long grey beard stained yellow at the tips, a battered leather cap, a patched grey smock under a leather apron, and a long iron rake over one shoulder.
npc_ulf_charcoal.combat: an old man with a rake, no fighter
npc_ulf_charcoal.personality: Slow, patient and odd; talks to his fires; trusts water he has boiled and nothing else.
npc_ulf_charcoal.values: patience, a well-banked fire, clean water
npc_ulf_charcoal.fears: forest fires, his hands shaking worse
npc_ulf_charcoal.authority: Burns charcoal for the smiths; knows every fire in the valley.
npc_ulf_charcoal.concerns: His hands shake too much this morning to strike a spark, and he wants his tea.

boil.text: Ulf boils his drinking water; he says river water carries the summer sickness.
boil.line: Boil it. Always boil it. River's full of the summer sickness.
boil.lead: Ulf says to boil river water before drinking it.

inn_news.text: The common room at the Ford Inn is where travellers trade news of the road and the city.
inn_news.line: Want news? Sit in the common room at the Ford Inn and listen.
inn_news.lead: Travellers trade news of the road in the Ford Inn's common room.

npc_ulf_charcoal.style: Slow and few words; speaks to the fire as often as to you.

samples: Small first. Grass, then twigs. Then wood. Fire's a child: feed it slow.
Never leave a fire alone. Never.
Boil it. I've buried men who didn't.
voice.habits: Calls fires 'she'; repeats his rules; nods slowly.
voice.greeting: Peers up from the clamp: 'Mind your feet. She's hot.'

npc_ulf_charcoal.likes: good oak, quiet mornings, boiled water

superstition.text: Ulf would want to know how it works.
